categories.main_business_segments: Victory Giant Technology (HuiZhou) Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-precision printed circuit boards (PCBs). Its product portfolio includes high-end multilayer boards, HDI boards, flexible printed circuits (FPC), and rigid-flex boards, serving sectors such as new energy, automotive electronics, next-generation communication, data centers, AI, industrial internet, medical devices, computing, and aerospace.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including high-density interconnect (HDI) PCB fabrication, multilayer PCB production up to 70 layers, and specialized processes like laser drilling, embedded components, and thick copper plating. It has developed proprietary technologies in areas such as high-frequency PCBs, automotive-grade PCBs, and AI server boards. The company operates a smart factory integrating MES, ERP, APS, WMS, and SRM systems for digitalized production and supply chain management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international top-tier clients in automotive electronics (notably electric vehicles), AI computing servers, communication infrastructure, and consumer electronics. The company serves industries such as new energy vehicles, AI and data centers, industrial control, medical instruments, aerospace, and next-generation communication technologies like 5G.
categories.geographic_coverage: Victory Giant Technology operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Huizhou and subsidiaries in regions including Shenzhen, Hunan, Yiyang, and Nantong. It has expanded globally through acquisitions and subsidiaries in the US, Singapore, Malaysia, Germany, Japan, and Hong Kong, supporting sales and technical services in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, focusing on PCB design, manufacturing, and assembly. It integrates upstream R&D and downstream customer collaboration, providing high-value PCB products and services to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in electronics manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation-driven growth with emphasis on smart factory development, green manufacturing, and high-technology product advancement. R&D focuses on AI servers, automotive electronics, 5G communication, industrial robotics, and new energy applications. The company invests heavily in new product development, process innovation, and intellectual property protection, maintaining over 400 patents and numerous ongoing R&D projects.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of high-precision PCB products to domestic and international customers. The company operates on a product sales model, supplemented by technical services and customized solutions. It also derives income from financial investments and government subsidies related to innovation and environmental initiatives.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Victory Giant Technology is a leading player in the global PCB industry, ranked among the top 100 PCB manufacturers worldwide and holding a top position in high-density multilayer and HDI PCB segments. It competes with major PCB manufacturers globally, leveraging advanced technology, comprehensive product offerings, and strong customer relationships to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 7.93 billion, a slight increase of 0.58% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders at RMB 671 million, reflecting a 15.09% decrease. The company has demonstrated steady growth over recent years, supported by strategic acquisitions and global expansion, with total assets exceeding RMB 17 billion and equity over RMB 7.6 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Victory Giant Technology emphasizes high technology, superior quality, and comprehensive service as its core value proposition. It offers advanced PCB solutions with high layer counts, fine pitch, and specialized materials tailored for cutting-edge applications like AI computing and automotive electronics. The company’s smart factory and green manufacturing initiatives enhance product reliability and sustainability, differentiating it in a competitive market.
